summary: Iteration 50 — full backend + frontend E2E validation of the trial onboarding wizard, superadmin pharmacy creation with mandatory admin account, cascade pharmacy deletion, and the new branch-deletion warning. Backend: 12/12 pytest tests pass (/app/backend/tests/test_iteration50.py). Frontend: all 8 requested flows pass (trial signup -> wizard, full 7-step wizard with 2 branches, branch persistence after re-login, 'Configurer plus tard' skip, no wizard on re-login, superadmin create-with-admin dialog + temp password display, delete-pharmacy typed confirmation, admin ph1 branch delete warning + cancel + confirm). No blocking defects found. All test pharmacies created during testing were deleted; only ph1 and ph_a89755dc remain in the table.

minor.issue: No plan_status is set on superadmin-created pharmacies, so they render as « Accès complet » immediately (no trial badge). Confirm this is the intended default vs. explicit plan_status='full'.
Idempotency/no-op: calling it again after completion silently returns ok:true and can overwrite address/city/hours. Low risk (admin-only), but no guard on already-completed onboarding.

issues: Progress label reads « question 1 de 5 » on step 1 and jumps to 7 total steps once 2+ branches are chosen — the denominator changes mid-flow, which can feel inconsistent (cosmetic).

The Loi-25 privacy consent dialog (privacy-consent-dialog) appears BEFORE the wizard right after trial signup; the wizard only renders after « J'ai lu et j'accepte ». Expected order per spec was wizard-first — automated flows must accept consent first (documented for next agent).

The nested branch-delete-confirm-dialog overlaps the parent branch-manager-dialog; during the open animation (~first 500ms) the two dialogs are visually superimposed and text is unreadable. Settled state is fine (opacity 1, opaque bg). Cosmetic only.

action_items: Optional: decide whether the privacy consent gate should be shown before or after the onboarding wizard for new trial signups.
Optional: keep the wizard step count stable (or show « question X » without a total) since the total changes when branch count > 1.
Optional: set an explicit plan_status on superadmin-created pharmacies instead of relying on the absence of the field.
critical_code_review_comments: TrialOnboarding.finalize(): if POST /api/onboarding succeeds but addBranch/refreshUser throws, the catch shows a generic error while onboarding is already marked complete server-side — branches would be silently lost. Consider creating branches first (or retry) and separating error messages.

TrialOnboarding: no validation on the address/city/hours steps — a user can click « Continuer » through every step with empty inputs and reach the summary (server accepts empty strings). Add light required-field validation if the data matters.
server.py is 8912 lines — well beyond the 700-line guideline; split superadmin/auth/onboarding routers into modules.
POST /api/onboarding does not verify the pharmacy exists (update_one with no upsert silently no-ops if pharmacy_id is stale) — returning ok:true regardless hides the failure.

rca_of_the_issue: No functional defect reproduced. Two initial test failures were test-side only (server lowercases emails; user payload uses snake_case pharmacy_id) and were fixed in the test file. The first frontend run failed because the Loi-25 privacy consent dialog gates the wizard — handled by accepting consent, not an app bug.
